points.description: States that the time-area method is used to produce/derive runoff hydrographs (hydrologic routing) from rainfall input such as the hyetograph (intensity vs time).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it is used for routing or runoff estimation without hydrograph/rainfall link.

points.description: States its significance: suited to larger catchments because it treats smaller regions/sub-areas separately (accounts for each area's contribution individually).
points.partial_credit: Half if only mentions larger catchments or dividing into areas, not both.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating the method gives runoff hydrographs from rainfall, and that it is useful for large catchments by handling sub-areas separately, in any wording. Give part marks for vague or one-sided versions of either idea. Give none for unrelated answers. Wrong extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the core idea.
